name: bodyweight standing close-grip one arm row
description: A standing one arm row with your body weight, leaning back from a wall bar and pulling yourself in. It works the muscles between and around the shoulder blades.
instructions: Stand facing a wall bar with your feet close to it.
Grip a rung at chest height with one hand.
Lean back until that arm is straight, body in a line from head to heels.
Pull your chest toward the bar, keeping your elbow close to your side.
Lower back slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
